monogr.title: The Judaeo-Arabic Commentary on Jonah by the Karaite Japheth Ben Eli: Introduction and Translation

biblStruct.note: Includes an English translation only of Yefet’s introduction, Judaeo-Arabic translation, and commentary on the book of Jonah, based on the 2000(?) edition of Marwick https://biblia-arabica.com/bibl/TSTXWHGZ. A few very brief remarks on the place of Yefet’s translation in his exegetical method are made on pp. 7–8. (Biblia Arabica)
